decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I encountered many non-backpack items like hammocks and camp chairs. After filtering for actual backpacks, I selected a consideration set that included tactical, hiking, packable, and sling options. I specifically focused on products with high social proof and features suitable for outdoor or daily use. The QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the best choice due to its excellent 4.7 rating over 6,000+ reviews and high volume-to-price ratio. It offered more versatility and durability than the lightweight packable options or the higher-priced technical hiking bags like the KAILAS 28L.
